facts.source_quote: NEW: Spironolactone 25 mg by mouth once daily
facts.detail: Start taking Spironolactone 25 mg once daily.

facts.source_quote: CHANGED: Furosemide increased from 20 mg to 40 mg by mouth twice daily (8 AM and 2 PM)
facts.detail: Increase furosemide dose to 40 mg twice daily, 8 AM and 2 PM.

facts.source_quote: HOLD: Ibuprofen - do not take until kidney function is rechecked by your cardiologist
facts.detail: Pause taking Ibuprofen until kidney function is rechecked by your cardiologist.

facts.source_quote: NEW: Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg by mouth twice daily. Do not take within 36 hours of your last lisinopril dose
facts.detail: Start taking Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg twice daily, do not take within 36 hours of your last Lisinopril dose.

facts.source_quote: CONTINUE: Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once daily
facts.detail: Continue taking Metoprolol succinate 50 mg once daily.

facts.source_quote: Return precautions: Return to the Emergency Department or call 911 for chest pain, shortness of breath at rest, or fainting
facts.detail: Return to the Emergency Department or call 911 for chest pain, shortness of breath at rest, or fainting.

facts.source_quote: Return precautions: Call the heart failure clinic at [PHONE_1] if weight increases by more than 2 lb in one day or 5 lb in one week, or if leg swelling worsens
facts.detail: Call the heart failure clinic at [PHONE_1] if weight increases by more than 2 lb in one day or 5 lb in one week, or if leg swelling worsens.

facts.source_quote: Diet: Sodium restriction < 2 g/day. Fluid restriction 1.5 L/day
facts.detail: Follow a sodium restriction of less than 2 g/day and fluid restriction of 1.5 L/day.

facts.source_quote: Activity: Weigh yourself every morning after urinating and before breakfast and record daily weights. Walk as tolerated; no lifting > 10 lb for 2 weeks
facts.detail: Weigh yourself every morning after urinating and before breakfast and record daily weights. Walk as tolerated, no lifting more than 10 lb for 2 weeks.

facts.source_quote: Follow-up: Heart failure clinic with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 AM. Basic metabolic panel (blood test) on 10/18/2026 at the outpatient lab
facts.detail: Schedule a follow-up appointment with the heart failure clinic on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 AM and a blood test on 10/18/2026 at the outpatient lab.

sentences.text: You will start taking Spironolactone 25 mg once daily.
You will increase furosemide to 40 mg twice daily, 8 AM and 2 PM.
Pause taking Ibuprofen until kidney function is rechecked by your cardiologist.
You will stop taking Lisinopril 10 mg daily.
You will start taking Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg twice daily, do not take within 36 hours of your last Lisinopril dose.
You will continue taking Metoprolol succinate 50 mg once daily.
Return to the Emergency Department or call 911 for chest pain, shortness of breath at rest, or fainting.
Call the heart failure clinic at [PHONE_1] if weight increases by more than 2 lb in one day or 5 lb in one week, or if leg swelling worsens.
Follow a sodium restriction of less than 2 g/day and fluid restriction of 1.5 L/day.
Weigh yourself every morning after urinating and before breakfast and record daily weights. Walk as tolerated, no lifting more than 10 lb for 2 weeks.
Schedule a follow-up appointment with the heart failure clinic on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 AM and a blood test on 10/18/2026 at the outpatient lab.

items.text: Tendrás que empezar a tomar Spironolactona 25 mg al día.
Tendrás que aumentar el furosemida a 40 mg al día, por la mañana y a la tarde.
Pausa la ibuprofeno hasta que se revise la función renal por tu cardiologista.
Tendrás que dejar de tomar Lisinopril 10 mg al día.
Tendrás que empezar a tomar Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg al día, no tomar dentro de 36 horas de tu última dosis de Lisinopril.
Tendrás que continuar tomando Metoprolol succinato 50 mg al día.
Regresa al Hospital de Emergencia o llama 911 si tienes dolor de pecho, dificultad para respirar a la hora de estar quieto o caerte.
Llama al centro de cardiología de corazón si el peso aumenta más de 2 libras en un día o 5 libras en una semana, o si el hinchaje de las piernas empeora.
Sigues una restricción de sodio de menos de 2 g al día y una restricción de líquidos de 1.5 L al día.
Peso cada mañana después de orinar y antes de la comida y registra los pesos diarios. Camina lo que puedas, no levantar más de 10 libras durante 2 semanas.
Programa una cita de seguimiento con el centro de cardiología de corazón el 21 de octubre de 2026 a las 10:30 AM y una prueba de sangre el 18 de octubre de 2026 en el laboratorio ambulatorio.
You will have to start taking Spironolactona 25 mg a day.
You will have to increase Furosemida to 40 mg a day, in the morning and in the afternoon.
Pause Ibuprofeno until your cardiologist reviews your renal function.
You will have to stop taking Lisinopril 10 mg a day.
You will have to start taking Sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg a day, do not take within 36 hours of your last dose of Lisinopril.
You will have to continue taking Metoprolol succinato 50 mg a day.
Return to the Emergency Hospital or call 911 if you have chest pain, difficulty breathing when at rest or falling.
Call the heart center of the heart if the weight increases more than 2 pounds in a day or 5 pounds in a week, or if the swelling of the legs worsens.
You follow a sodium restriction of less than 2 g a day and a fluid restriction of 1.5 L a day.
Weigh yourself every morning after urinating and before eating and record daily weights. Walk as much as you can, do not lift more than 10 pounds for 2 weeks.
Schedule a follow-up appointment with the heart center of the heart on October 21, 2026, at 10:30 AM, and a blood test on October 18, 2026, at the outpatient laboratory.
